name: Tri-culture, dissociation, quench, cell wash and filter chip
description: Grows three iPSC-derived populations in separate chambers (apart, then sharing medium through the central junction), detaches them, quenches the enzyme, moves the cells into clean buffer and filters out clumps. Parametric parts: modules split_1, culture_neurons, culture_microglia, culture_astrocytes, junction_mid, quench_join, quench_mix, cell_wash use the nearest library block as a stand-in (real part and sizing in autochip_part / params). Modules listed in missing_parts with a 'module' field are parametric with no library block. build_chip.py builds the stand-ins at library size; the exact chip needs the autochip layout stage.

modules.does: Feeds the seeded cells from inlet_1 to the three culture chambers, one population each.

Neurons grow in their own chamber fed from their own medium line. This line also carries the dissociation enzyme later. In the shared phase this chamber is the one fed, and medium crosses the junction to the others.
Microglia grow in their own chamber fed from their own medium line, which also carries the dissociation enzyme. It vents through its own outlet when medium is shared.
Astrocytes grow in their own chamber fed from their own medium line, which also carries the dissociation enzyme. It vents through its own outlet when medium is shared.
Central junction joining the three chambers: apart, each vents through it; sharing, medium crosses here. After detaching, cells from all chambers leave through it.
Quench solution joins the detached cell stream.
Mixes the quench solution into the cell stream.
Inertial spiral moves cells into clean wash buffer, replacing the centrifuge pellet and the resuspension in wash buffer.

off_chip.why: Cell counting and viability check are bench steps; the cell counter is not in the lab equipment list.

missing_parts.why: parametric part with no library block; the autochip layout stage draws it

steps_text.1: Culture neurons, microglia and astrocytes in separate vessels, side by side, each in its own medium.
steps_text.2: Continue culture of the three cell types sharing medium (co-culture or shared medium flow).
steps_text.3: Detach the cells with a dissociation enzyme.
steps_text.5: Centrifuge the cell suspension to pellet the cells.
steps_text.6: Resuspend the cells in wash buffer.
steps_text.7: Filter the suspension through a cell strainer to remove clumps.
